name: Bugalou for WooCommerce – Live Chat, Order Answers & Sale Banners
author: Bugalou

sections.description:
Bugalou is a free WooCommerce live chat plugin with an AI chatbot that answers order, tracking and shipping questions for you, and one shared customer support inbox for WhatsApp, email, Instagram and Facebook Messenger.

“Where is my order?” is the question every WooCommerce store gets most. With Bugalou, the AI chatbot looks up the order in your store and answers right away, day and night. When a customer needs a person, your team takes over with the customer’s orders right next to the chat.

💬 Free live chat for your WooCommerce store

Start with the free plan: live chat on your store for 1 user and up to 50 conversations a month, free forever, no credit card needed.

  • Live chat on every page of your WooCommerce shop
  • Shoppers can share their name, email and files in the chat
  • The chat follows the shopper’s language
  • Conversations continue across pages, so shoppers never lose their chat
  • Colours, texts and opening hours managed from your Bugalou dashboard
  • Loads asynchronously, so your store stays fast
  • Optional and off by default: you switch the chat on when you’re ready

📦 AI chatbot that answers order and tracking questions

Connect your store and Bugalou reads your WooCommerce orders, so the AI chatbot (Pro plan) can answer the questions that take up most of your customer service time:

  • Live order status and payment status
  • Tracking information and expected delivery
  • Backordered items, with an explanation of the delay
  • Product and shipping questions, based on your store’s own data
  • Hands off to your team whenever a customer asks for a person, with the full history

🛒 WooCommerce orders next to every conversation

When a customer contacts you, by live chat, WhatsApp, email or Instagram, your team sees their WooCommerce orders right next to the conversation. No more switching between WordPress and your inbox to look up an order number.

📲 Automatic WhatsApp and email order updates

Send customers a message when something happens with their order, automatically:

  • Order confirmation when a new order is placed
  • A shipping update with track & trace when the order ships
  • A message when the order is delivered

Combine it with the Sendcloud or MyParcel integration to send updates for every shipping status, and to let customers know when a parcel is delayed.

📥 One inbox for live chat, WhatsApp, email, Instagram and Messenger

  • Live chat on your WooCommerce store
  • WhatsApp Business: chat with customers on WhatsApp, with message templates (and broadcasts on Pro)
  • Email: connect Gmail, Outlook or any IMAP mailbox
  • Instagram DMs and Facebook Messenger, including replies to comments under your posts
  • Phone and SMS via Twilio (Pro plan)

Your whole team answers every channel from the same inbox, with assignment, internal notes and @mentions, snippets (canned responses), follow-up reminders and reports.

🏷️ Sale banners with countdown timer

Announce Black Friday, free shipping or a new collection in a bar on top of your store. You create banners in your Bugalou dashboard under Campaigns → Banners and they show up on your store automatically once the chat widget is on. No extra plugin or code needed.

  • Free plan: 1 active banner with your text, colours and a link
  • Paid plans: a live countdown timer, a discount code with a copy button, a newsletter signup form, a button that opens the chat, ready-made templates (Black Friday, Christmas, Sale) and showing banners only on certain pages or devices

🔄 Returns and more integrations

Bugalou also connects with Returnless for returns (Pro), Sendcloud and MyParcel for shipping, and bol.com, Shopify and Lightspeed if you sell on more channels. Every order and every customer question lands in the same place.

🔒 GDPR and data in the EU

Bugalou stores customer data on servers in the EU (Frankfurt) and is fully GDPR-compliant, with a data processing agreement for every customer. Store access goes through WooCommerce’s own authorization screen, and the plugin loads nothing on your store until you switch the chat on. See “External services” below for exactly what is sent.

How it works

  1. Install and activate this plugin.
  2. Log in to your Bugalou dashboard and go to Channels → WooCommerce.
  3. Under “Connect via plugin”, click “Generate connect code” and copy the code.
  4. In your WordPress admin, go to WooCommerce → Bugalou, paste the code, and click Connect.
  5. Approve the connection on WooCommerce’s own authorization screen.

That’s it — Bugalou automatically sets up the order webhooks it needs. No manual API key copying required.

Live chat widget (optional)

Want the Bugalou live chat on your store? In the Bugalou dashboard, go to Channels → Website chat → Installation and click “Copy key” in the “Widget key” box, paste it under WooCommerce → Bugalou → Website chat widget, tick “Show the chat widget on my store” and save. No theme editing needed. The widget’s colours, texts and AI behaviour are managed in your Bugalou dashboard.

Bugalou account required

This plugin connects your store to Bugalou, an external service, so you need a Bugalou account to use it.

  • Free plan: the live chat widget on your store, for 1 user and up to 50 conversations a month, and 1 sale banner, free forever. No AI chatbot, and “Powered by Bugalou” is shown in the chat and the banner.
  • Starter: connect your WooCommerce store (orders in the inbox, order notifications), WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and email in one inbox, automations and countdown banners.
  • Pro: everything in Starter plus the AI chatbot that answers order questions, routing, CSAT, Returnless, broadcasts and phone and SMS.

Every paid plan starts with a free 14-day trial. See all plans on the pricing page.

External services

This plugin connects your store to Bugalou, an external customer service platform.

  • What is sent, and when: only when you click “Connect to Bugalou”, your browser goes to WooCommerce’s own authorization screen on your site. After you approve, WooCommerce (not this plugin) sends a REST API Consumer Key/Secret for your store, your store URL and the connect code to Bugalou’s server at https://app.bugalou.com/api/woocommerce/oauth/callback.
  • What Bugalou does with it: Bugalou uses this access to read order, product and customer information (name, email, phone, shipping address, order status) and to register order webhooks, solely to power customer service replies and order notifications for your store.
  • Live chat widget (optional, off by default): only when you paste a widget key and enable “Show the chat widget on my store”, your store loads Bugalou’s chat script from https://bugalou.com/widget/loader.js for visitors. The script loads your widget settings from https://bugalou.com and, when a visitor uses the chat, sends the messages they type, any name, email or file they choose to share and their browser language to Bugalou, so your team and the AI assistant can answer in your Bugalou inbox. As with any web request, the visitor’s IP address and the page address are visible to Bugalou’s server. The script stores a chat session id in the visitor’s browser (local storage) so the conversation continues across pages.
  • Announcement banners: the same chat script also loads Bugalou’s banner script from https://bugalou.com/banners/widget.js when your Bugalou account has an active banner. To pick the banners for the page, it sends the page path and whether the visitor uses a mobile or desktop device to Bugalou, and it reports when a banner is shown, clicked or closed (no visitor data, only the banner id). Only when a visitor types their email address into a banner’s signup form is that address sent to Bugalou and saved as a contact in your account. Closed banners and signups are remembered in the visitor’s browser (local storage), so a closed banner stays closed on your store.

  • Apart from the above, the plugin sends no data, loads no remote scripts and does not track visitors.

  • Bugalou terms of service

  • Bugalou privacy policy
sections.installation:
Watch the setup in one minute:

  1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/bugalou-for-woocommerce, or install it directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Bugalou to connect your store.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Bugalou account?

Yes. The live chat widget works on Bugalou’s free plan. Connecting your store needs a paid plan, which starts with a free 14-day trial.

What WooCommerce permissions does this plugin request?

Read/write access to orders, products, and webhooks — needed to look up order status and register the webhooks Bugalou uses to detect new and updated orders.

Do I need to connect my store to use the chat widget?

No. The widget works with just your widget key. Connecting the store as well lets the chat answer order questions with live order data.

How do I add a sale banner with a countdown?

Switch on the chat widget first (see above). Then, in your Bugalou dashboard, go to Campaigns → Banners, click “Create banner”, pick the Black Friday template or write your own text, switch on the countdown and click Activate. The countdown timer and discount codes are part of the paid plans.

Does this plugin work with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes, this plugin is fully compatible with HPOS.

Is the live chat free?

Yes. The free plan includes live chat on your store for 1 user and up to 50 conversations a month, with no time limit and no credit card. Connecting your orders and the AI chatbot are part of the paid plans.

Can the AI chatbot answer “where is my order?” questions?

Yes, on the Pro plan. Once your store is connected, the AI chatbot looks up the order and answers with the live status, payment status and tracking information. When it can’t help, it hands the conversation to your team.

Can I send WhatsApp messages when an order ships?

Yes, from the Starter plan. Set up an automation in Bugalou that sends a WhatsApp or email message when an order is placed, shipped or completed.

Does the chat slow down my store?

No. The script loads asynchronously in the footer, after your page content, and only once you switch the chat on.

Can my whole team answer customers?

Yes. Invite colleagues to your Bugalou account and assign conversations to them, by hand or automatically. Extra users cost €12 per user per month on Starter and Pro.

Is Bugalou GDPR compliant?

Yes. Customer data is stored in the EU (Frankfurt) and a data processing agreement is included. Store access goes through WooCommerce’s own authorization screen.
